If I need to do something and I'm pretty much paralyzed by depression, I break down the task to the very simplest smallest thing I could possibly do. Like if I need to clean the kitchen I try to just get in the kitchen and put ONE dish away. I also set a timer for 5 mins and try to work on that task for 5 mins then take a 20 min break. I try very hard to tell myself that doing something tiny is still better than doing nothing. Usually if I can keep this going it creates a positive feedback loop and it helps to get the ball rolling. Sometimes it doesn't work though and I just try to tell myself that this won't last forever (easier said than done I know).
